# obix-runtime-reactivity

> Previous name: `@obinexusltd/obix-runtime-reactivity` — OBIX packages are named without an npm scope since decision D-102 (2026-09-29); the package, its version and its exports are unchanged.

The reactivity of OBIX's native runtime, its own: ref, computed, watch, effects with dependency tracking, batching, an ordered update queue and cleanup. No framework, no DOM. Phase 6 (docs/recovery/native-runtime.md).

<!-- obix-release:begin — generated by scripts/release/prepare.mjs; edit the text above this line -->

## Installation

```bash
npm install obix-runtime-reactivity
```

## Basic usage

```js
import { EffectHandle, EffectScope, ObixRuntimeError, batch } from 'obix-runtime-reactivity';
```

## API surface

- `obix-runtime-reactivity` — 18 value exports: `EffectHandle`, `EffectScope`, `ObixRuntimeError`, `batch`, `computed`, `effect`, `effectScope`, `flushJobs`, `getCurrentScope`, `hasPendingJobs`, `isRef`, `liveEffects`, `nextTick`, `onScopeDispose`, `queueJob`, `ref`, `untracked`, `watch`
- Type declarations: `./dist/index.d.ts` (and a declaration next to every JS entry point).

## Architecture role

`obix-runtime-reactivity` is a **public building block**: the umbrella `obix` depends on it and re-exports its stable API, so applications normally reach it through `obix`; it can also be installed on its own.

The architecture of OBIX — the package families and which packages are public API — is indexed in the umbrella: [docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/obinexus/obix/blob/main/docs/architecture.md).

## Package relationships

- Depends on (OBIX): no other OBIX package.
- Used by (OBIX): [`obix`](https://github.com/obinexus/obix), [`obix-runtime-browser`](https://github.com/obinexus/obix-runtime-browser), [`obix-runtime-component`](https://github.com/obinexus/obix-runtime-component), [`obix-runtime-dom`](https://github.com/obinexus/obix-runtime-dom).

## Testing

- 6 test files ship in the npm package (`test/`): the evidence of the package's contract, published so that its verification can be inspected — not runtime code (no entry point reaches them).
- **Standalone**: 6 of 6 — they read nothing outside the package.
- Run them with `npm test` (`node --test "test/*.test.mjs"`) in the OBIX monorepo, which provides the test tooling (Node's test runner, TypeScript) and the harness.
